title: From Fidel Castro to Patrick Star in five photos
description: Two presidents, a Star Wars legend and a Hollywood ceremony connect Fidel Castro to Patrick Star, through the voice of Patrick, Bill Fagerbakke.
hook: How is Fidel Castro connected to Patrick Star?

image.file: File:Enrique Peña Nieto y Fidel Castro.jpg

links.line: In 2014, Mexican president Enrique Peña Nieto visited Fidel Castro in Havana.

image.file: File:Joe Biden with Enrique Peña Nieto in Mexico City.jpg

links.line: In 2016, Vice President Joe Biden flew to Mexico City for talks with Peña Nieto.
In 2024, Star Wars legend Mark Hamill visited President Biden in the Oval Office.

image.credit: Getty Images for Paramount Pictures, via Mulderville

links.line: In 2025, Hamill joined the SpongeBob cast, including Bill Fagerbakke, at a Hollywood handprint ceremony.
And Bill Fagerbakke has been the voice of Patrick Star since 1999.
